questions.question:
y = 3x + 9
3y = 8x − 6
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of x − y?
questions.explanation: 3(3x + 9) = 8x − 6 gives x = −33 and y = −90, so x − y = 57.

questions.question: An employee earns $30 per hour for the first 40 hours worked in a week. For each hour worked over 40 hours, the employee earns $45 per hour. What is the least number of whole hours that the employee must work in a week to earn at least $1,610?

questions.question: Alex engages in up to 3 types of exercise each week for a total of 9 hours while training for a triathlon. Alex swims for the same number of <u>minutes</u> each week. The equation y = 540 − x − 200 represents the situation where Alex bikes for x minutes during a week and runs for any remaining training time y, in minutes. If this equation is graphed in the xy-plane, which statement is the best interpretation of the x-intercept of the graph?
options: During a week when Alex swims for 340 minutes, he bikes for 200 minutes.
Each week, Alex bikes and runs for a total of 340 minutes.
During a week when Alex doesn’t bike, he runs for 340 minutes.
During a week when Alex doesn’t run, he bikes for 340 minutes.
questions.explanation: At the x-intercept y = 0 (no running), and then x = 340 minutes of biking.

questions.question: Sabrina has a goal to save at least $240. She has already saved $180. If x represents the additional amount of money, in dollars, Sabrina needs to save to meet her goal, which inequality represents this situation?
questions.explanation: Her total, 180 + x, must be at least 240.

questions.question: A carpenter charges a flat rate of $306 for the first 3 hours of work and $85 for each additional hour of work. Which equation gives the total amount y, in dollars, that the carpenter charges for x hours of work, where x > 3?

James purchased a certain baseball card on January 1. The function f(x) = 55(1.04)<sup>x</sup>, where 0 ≤ x ≤ 10, gives the predicted value, in dollars, of the baseball card x years after James purchased it. What is the best interpretation of the statement “f(7) is approximately equal to 72” in this context?
options: When the baseball card’s predicted value is approximately 72 dollars, it is 7% greater than the predicted value, in dollars, on January 1 of the previous year.
When the baseball card’s predicted value is approximately 72 dollars, it is 7 times the predicted value, in dollars, on January 1 of the previous year.
From the day James purchased the baseball card to 7 years after James purchased the card, its predicted value increased by a total of approximately 72 dollars.
7 years after James purchased the baseball card, its predicted value is approximately 72 dollars.
questions.explanation: f(7) is the predicted value 7 years after purchase, so D (55 · 1.04⁷ ≈ 72.4).

A soccer team's goal is to earn at least $1,320 by selling coupon books. The team earns $12 from selling each coupon book. Which of the following inequalities describes all possible values for the number of coupon books, n, the team can sell to meet the goal?
questions.explanation: Earnings 12n must be at least 1,320, so 12n ≥ 1,320.

questions.question: The graph of the function f, where y = f(x), gives the total cost y, in dollars, for a certain video game system and x games. What is the best interpretation of the slope of the graph in this context?
questions.explanation: The line goes from (0, 50) to (10, 210), so the slope is 160/10 = 16 dollars per game; the y-intercept 50 is the system's cost.

questions.question: The shaded region shown represents the solutions to rx + ty ≥ −44, where r and t are constants. What is the value of r + t?
questions.explanation: The boundary line passes through (0, −11) and (−4, −10), so y = −x/4 − 11, or x + 4y = −44. The shaded region is above it, so r = 1, t = 4 and r + t = 5.

Less than 18 years old26%

Greater than 65 years old24%

The table shows the distribution of people in a certain city by age group. If a person in this city is selected at random, which of the following is closest to the probability of selecting a person who is greater than 65 years old, given that the person is at least 18 years old?
questions.explanation: People at least 18 years old make up 100% − 26% = 74%, and 24% of all people are over 65, so the probability is 24/74 ≈ 0.32.
